name: Awa (Temples 1-23)
summary: The first of the four dōjō: Temple 1 Ryōzen-ji to Temple 23 Yakuō-ji, 154.5 km along 22 temple-to-temple henro trail relations. The gentlest of the four to pace — no leg between two temples runs longer than 22.7 km, so every day of it can end at a temple. Awa carries the first of the four stages of spiritual progression the pilgrimage maps onto Shikoku's four provinces: awakening.
